polling.generic_ballot_series_role: Silver forecast-page likely-voter average shown for context; not an additional likelihood

house_structural_validation.scope: House structural model conditional on realized national House margin

gate.rule: Candidate must match the best baseline within 0.005 Brier/0.01 log loss, have <=1.5-point signed error, and cover both seat outcomes at 90%.

house_structural_validation.limitation: This validates the House margin-to-seat layer, not Silver Bulletin's maintained-average calibration.

data_sources.house_partisan_lean: Cook Political Report current-map Cook PVI

fundamentals.incumbent_source: Clerk of the House + FEC candidate master

diagnostics.race_poll_calibration_source: robust MAD of final-60-day pollster-balanced race-average errors
